images.tooltip: Clip frames to lay the heat map over (a dimmed grayscale copy).

output_tooltips: |alpha_t - alpha_t-1| per pixel, or with a reference |change - reference change|; frame 0 is 0.
Mean |a_t - (a_t-1 + a_t+1) / 2| over the clip; lower is steadier.
CorridorKey2TemporalStability.name: CorridorKey2TemporalStability
CorridorKey2TemporalStability.description: Measures how steady a matte is over time. Without a reference: per-frame change and flicker (change that steady motion would not explain). With a ground-truth reference: SAD, MSE, gradient error and dtSSD (temporal coherence error) per frame. The heat map shows where the matte changes between frames (or, with a reference, where its change differs from the reference's).
